findings.title: A pending QR image import overwrites newer field input
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A supported input publication race is established; no unauthorized download, external disclosure, incorrect derived key or broken mandatory isolation gate was demonstrated.
findings.reproduction: qr-races-v3: start with nonempty synthetic input; defer native bitmap decode, edit the target to new text or empty and emit input, then release the decoder. Both current-field assertions fail. This is not an actual global Clear-button test.
findings.expected: Edits and Clear revoke prior imports; outdated operations cannot replace current data.
findings.observed: The real FileChoice snapshots chosen files before clearing its input; the real importer awaits the browser bitmap boundary, invokes the real QR decoder and unconditionally assigns target.value and emits input. There is no input-revision listener or caller-provided revocation predicate. qr-races-v2 records the explicit new text being replaced by the distinct literal QR payload after deferred completion. Real recovery installers use this importer and supply no lifetime guard.
findings.impact: Incorrect source input or resurfacing of previously cleared synthetic recovery data, offline and user-triggered; no provider disclosure or wrong-key computation demonstrated.
findings.evidence: qr-races-v3.command.json / qr-races-v3.log: two field-edit failures; the third case belongs to Window listener retention. Real importer/chooser/QR encoder and pixel decoder; passive bitmap/canvas/DOM only.
findings.recommendedFix: Give the import operation an owned revision/lifetime checked after awaited boundaries and before callbacks/publication; integrate actual caller clearing/replacement and discard cleanup. Preserve multi-file append semantics.
findings.requiredVerification: Bounded tests through the real installer for typed edit, genuine nonempty-to-empty edit, actual applicable Clear control, newer competing import, rejection and removal/page departure. Do not relabel the current synthetic seam as native browser image acceptance.

findings.title: Window pagehide callbacks retain detached sensitive QR card contexts
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Avoidable lifetime extension and accumulating detached contexts are supported; no readable stale export or externally accessible secret was established.
findings.reproduction: Create real QR action, append and remove it. Window pagehide listener remains; no disposal capability or listener unregister. Runtime audit test fails expected release. findings.expected: Cleared/replaced secret DOM references are released where practical; CORE24/TS07 and SECURITY_AUDIT.md:36.

Sensitive shares call createQrAction with the share at 596 and carry a sibling text node at 583. Replacing result children removes the card without an available QR disposal method or Window unregister path. once:true only bounds this registration by pagehide, not by removal; repeated generations register more callbacks within the same document.
findings.impact: Explicit reachable secret/display buffers live longer after UI clear and repeated renders grow memory; no heap extraction, network egress or guaranteed erasure claim established.

independentChallenge.title: Public saved-card advice counts duplicate SSKR records as independent shares
independentChallenge.defense: Normal ShareCardSet.create invokes Share.readSet(records,false), which rejects duplicate member identities. Production card creation routes through that owner. A handcrafted file object therefore does not prove the ordinary card UI emits wrong recovery advice.
independentChallenge.counterevidence: shareKeepingNote is independently exported and explicitly discusses repeated printing/fewer-than-quorum inputs. It reads only records[0] and compares its memberThreshold with raw records.length, ignoring distinct group/member identity. mnemoCodeCardSavedNote is also exported with a structural MnemoCodeCardFile type; neither its type nor its function requires a branded validated card owner or checks distinct records. Valid same-set [s0,s0] from a2-of-3 set produces 'All 2 shares are needed' although only one distinct member is present. This is a real direct API copy/availability defect, not an unsupported encoding or impossible shape.
independentChallenge.harnessReview: Actual host mnemoCodeCardSavedNote import and retained public sskrSetVector. Two distinct same-set members first produce the correct all-two message; replacing records with two copies of the first member leaves that same misleading message and fails the assertion. No PDF/file output, Worker, KDF or WASM execution. Existing tests cover a single below-quorum record, not two duplicate records.
independentChallenge.scope: Direct saved-note/helper contract only; normal validated card creation remains guarded. No claim the note changes quorum mathematics, bypasses recovery or that a wallet loss occurred.
independentChallenge.recommendedFix: Count distinct group/member identities and validate set consistency in the reusable advice owner, or require a validated fact object while explicitly supporting below-quorum/repeated-print notes.
independentChallenge.requiredVerification: Two distinct2-of-3 controls, duplicate same-format/alternate-format records, below-quorum repeated prints, mixed set/group refusal or safe wording, and unchanged normal card-note outputs.

limitations: This is a whole-repository baseline with bounded execution, not release acceptance, independent cryptographic certification, proof of absence of defects or completion of the CORE migration.

Full default/selective matrix, real Chromium/Firefox/file lifecycle/layout/accessibility, native launchers/OSes, canonical Docker/WASM regeneration, full-cost vector/KDF replays, external Core RPC/hardware-wallet/provider/chain conformance and live funds were not executed.

Published cryptographic source/specification/vector call paths were reviewed locally; transitive dependency implementations and upstream source/specification freshness were not exhaustively re-audited. No timing/optimizer/guaranteed-erasure proof.
Advisory lookup timed out with no usable response; unavailable scanner/fuzzer/collector/native workflows are not passes.12mutationpreview candidates are not12bugs; no compiled mutation campaign.

1667file identity coverage and4548syntactic declarations do not imply1667complete semantic proofs or4548active runtime operations. Per-file method, operation family traces and separate completeness limits control the claim.

The307audit-directory allocation includes295retained historical paths plus12current procedural resources. Historical assertions retain structural/provenance limits and are not replayed; current shared Python helpers were read in full. External release/distribution claims were not newly authenticated.

Passive DOM/Worker/fetch/canvas/subtle boundaries exercise actual host modules but do not establish native rendering, scheduling, structured clone, CSP, download/clipboard permissions, extraction or GC behavior.

Producer sessions remain independent. New peer candidates are not silently imported into this frozen audit; direct-library candidates need exact producer contracts and host reachability before adoption.

No baseline production/test/dependency/workflow/vendor fix, commit, push, tag, release or paid CI dispatch occurred. All audit failures are retained for a separate remediation phase after this report.
